'''2020 Corona Cup''' (also called '''Corona Cup 2020''' and the '''2020 European Cup''' or '''2020 Euro Cup''') was an online team tournament on [[GEMP]] held in October 2020 and co-organized by [[Tamás Papp]] and "Kevin".<ref name="slack-cc20">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, Players Committee Twitter feed (@swccg), 20–27 October 2020: “a 'WIN & IN' game into the Online Euros FINAL CONFRONTATION. CRG / Team H-Town-Crew will play G2 of his match w/ Fox / Team Frostwurzel in the new/unique VIRTUAL REALITY format. CRG won G1 +6.” (20 October 2020); “Euro Cup Final Confrontation about to kick off (12pm Eastern) with the Open leg - zlorfik vs mightymaul” (24 October 2020); “Game 1 of the Jawa Format leg of Euro Cup Final Confrontation ... Match is between Silverglen & alex1” (24 October 2020); “Zlorfik wins G1 +17” (24 October 2020); “Silverglen wins G1 by +26. Team H-Town Crew has a hill to climb, but game 4 of 6 (Jawa format) for the Euro Cup final confrontation is coming up momentarily” (24 October 2020); “The last match of the 2020 Euro Cup Final Confrontation takes place today! CRG needs two big wins vs. MHT in the Virtual Reality format for his team to win the event.” (27 October 2020); “Congrats to Team "A German, an Englishman & a Canadian Walk into a Bar..." for winning the 2020 European Cup! Also congrats to Team H-Town-Crew for a 2nd place run. Thanks to Tamas & Kevin for organizing” (27 October 2020).</ref><ref name="cc20-forum">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1318909#p1318909 Corona Cup 2020 - Final Confrontation], Tamás Papp (Yoda007), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums (22 October 2020). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261124233352/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1318909.html Internet Archive]</ref> Team "A German, an Englishman & a Canadian Walk into a Bar..." defeated Team H-Town-Crew in the Final Confrontation, which concluded on 27 October 2020.<ref name="slack-cc20" />

== Format ==

* '''Environments:''' [[Open]], [[Jawa Format]], Virtual Reality<ref name="slack-cc20" />
* '''Site:''' [[GEMP]] (teams)
* '''Dates:''' 1–27 October 2020 (posted as 1–25 October 2020 on 22 October; Final Confrontation ended 27 October)<ref name="cc20-forum" /><ref name="slack-cc20" />
* '''Organizers:''' [[Tamás Papp]], "Kevin"<ref name="slack-cc20" /><ref name="cc20-forum" />
